headline: Last Year Devastating, This Year Drought Again: Corn Yield Halved in Some Places, Sunflower Holding Up
summary: A heat wave and drought are reducing corn yields in some areas of Serbia, with yields halved in places, while sunflower crops are holding up better.
why: Corn and sunflowers are major crops in the Balkans, and harvest shortfalls affect farm incomes, food prices and agricultural trade.
